title: Sei AI vs Tidalwave: The Borrower POS and the Managed Loan Behind It
summary: A mortgage-specific comparison of Sei AI and Tidalwave — a borrower-facing point-of-sale experience versus a fully managed lender platform spanning sales voice, underwriting, income calculation, closing, and QC.
